Good morning. Andrew **here** , thinking yet again about how the only apparent
bulwarks in this country against **Donald Trump 's** increasingly fascist
presidency are his insistence on maintaining his failed war in Iran and
wrecking the global economy, and his absolute refusal to stop bragging about
how great things are.

Yes, he even needs to brag about _high gas prices_ , rubbing it in Americans'
faces.

In today's **' First Draft,'** the president once again demonstrates he is
America's most out-of-touch billionaire, while also clarifying his willingness
to discard law and convention to go after enemies and targets for his hate, in
the continued hounding of **Ilhan Omar.** Let's read in.

There was a wave of brutal economic news on Wednesday, the result of Donald
Trump's illegal, pointless, failed, unending war with Iran.

Inflation is [surging](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/14/cpi-inflation-
breakdown-september-2026.html), as gasoline and fuel prices spike. Americans'
real weekly earnings
[fell](https://x.com/talmonsmith/status/2110356085462737201) year-over-year,
for the [sixth month](https://x.com/SteveRattner/status/2110380922713297347)
in a row. Home-buying has
[fallen](https://x.com/kenklippenstein/status/2110399878085902769) to its
lowest level since the aftermath of the 2009 housing crash.

Even CNBC's Jim Cramer understands why ordinary Americans are fed up and
feeling left out. Looking at the real wage data, the hyper-capitalist blowhard
[said](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2110400262841991455): **" Look, rich
people are making a lot of money. God, I sound like Marx. I really don't want
to sound like Marx. It's just, I'm looking at the data."**

There was no such awareness from the president, of course. He responded to the
news by [bragging](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-
trump-speech-midterm-political-rally-bullhead-city-arizona-october-14-2026/)…
that gas prices are so high.

**" I never say this because - and watch, they'll cut all of this stuff
out,"** he began, before saying the exact thing he knew he shouldn't. **" Our
country is making more money than it's ever made because of the fact that oil
is so high."**

Trump was speaking to supporters at a rally in Arizona. He wasn't done.

**" Now, they're going to say: **_**Isn 't it terrible? He talked about the
fact that he doesn't care about the little person**_**… I care more about the
little person than I care about the big person. I care about the little person
like crazy,"** he lied.** "But the fact is, because of the price of oil, Texas
and Oklahoma and North Dakota and all these places, we're making a fortune."**

The MAGA crowd didn't react. How didn't they groan? That wasn't all Trump had
to say about gas prices, either.
